name: cable lying bench single arm cross lateral raise
description: A one-armed lying lateral raise across the body with a low cable. It isolates a single side delt and lets you fix imbalances.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
